impressum.banner: Open-Source Software Attribution & Self-Hosted Deployment Notice:
impressum.operatorBody: Switchr is distributed as free, open-source software and is not hosted or operated as a central service by the author. Whoever deploys and hosts this instance is solely responsible as its operator, including compliance with any applicable local legal or statutory notice requirements (such as § 5 DDG / § 18 MStV in Germany, where applicable).

privacy.banner: Data Protection & Privacy Information for Self-Hosted Deployments (EU GDPR / DSGVO):
privacy.controllerBody: Because Switchr runs entirely on self-hosted infrastructure, the organization or individual operating this deployed instance is the data controller within the meaning of the GDPR. The software author (Christian Leinen) does not host this application and receives no telemetry, usage data, or operational logs from it.
privacy.connectionHeading: 2. Collection and Processing of Connection Data
privacy.connectionBody: When accessing a self-hosted Switchr dashboard, standard HTTP server connection logs (such as IP address, access timestamp, and user agent) may be processed locally by the host infrastructure to ensure stable system operations and network security (Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, where applicable).
privacy.auditBody: Audit logs and transaction histories stored locally by Switchr record technical host state, remote script execution exit codes, and profile transition records for infrastructure maintenance purposes. No advertising trackers, third-party analytics cookies, external telemetry, or behavioral profiling are included in the software.
privacy.rightsBody: Where the GDPR applies, you may exercise your rights regarding personal data—including access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), objection (Art. 21), and lodging a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77)—directly with the operator of this Switchr instance.

disclaimer.automationBody: The Switchr application executes remote automation scripts and configuration profiles on target machines. All profile definitions and scripts must be thoroughly verified before deployment in production environments. Authors and contributors assume no liability for service downtime, data loss, or misconfigurations resulting from executed scripts or configurations.
